related_issues.reason: Earlier closed bug about uv python install not respecting rc qualifiers (3.13.0rc3 installed rc2).
Pre-release/rc handling when requesting a Python version (3.14.0 resolving to rc).

rationale: uv python list --only-downloads advertises cpython-3.14.5rc1 but uv python install rejects both 3.14.5rc1 and the full key as not a valid download request, an inconsistency with a clear command, output and version (0.11.9). Searches found no exact duplicate, only related rc-handling issues (7977, 16175). The secondary ask (also list the latest stable per minor) is a minor enhancement. Docs were not read in depth.
